verses.uthmani: حمٓ
verses.indopak: حٰمٓ ۚ
verses.saheeh: Ha, Meem.
verses.khattab: Ḥâ-Mĩm
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Hā mīm: God knows best what He means by these [letters].
verses.romanUrdu: Haa Meem

verses.uthmani: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
verses.indopak: وَالْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِيْنِ ۙ
verses.saheeh: By the clear Book,
verses.khattab: By the clear Book
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By the Book, the Qur'an, that clarifies, the one that distinguishes what is lawful from what is unlawful.
verses.romanUrdu: Kasam hai is kitaab e Mubeen ki

verses.uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةٖ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّاۤ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ فِىْ لَيْلَةٍ مُّبٰـرَكَةٍ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُنْذِرِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: inna anzalnahu fee laylatin mubarakatin inna kunna munthireena
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
verses.khattab: Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night, for We always warn ˹against evil˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed We revealed it on a blessed night, the Night of Ordainment (laylat al-qadr), or the eve of the middle of Sha‘bān, in which it was revealed from the Mother Book, from the seventh heaven to the heaven of this world. Indeed We have been warning, We have been causing [people] by it to have fear [of God].
verses.romanUrdu: Ke humne isey ek badi khair o barakat wali raat mein nazil kiya hai, kyunke hum logon ko mutanabbeh (warning) karne ka irada rakhte thay

verses.uthmani: فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ
verses.indopak: فِيْهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ اَمْرٍ حَكِيْمٍ ۙ
verses.saheeh: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -
verses.khattab: On that night every matter of wisdom is ordained
verses.jalalayn: ﻿In it, that is to say, on the Night of Ordainment, or on the eve of the middle of Sha‘bān, every definitive matter, that has been fixed, with regard to the provisions and the terms of life and other things [decreed by God] for the entire year until that same night again [the following year], is distinguished, is decided.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh woh raat thi jismein har maamle ka hakeemana faisla

verses.uthmani: أَمۡرٗا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
verses.indopak: اَمْرًا مِّنْ عِنْدِنَا ۗ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِيْنَ ۚ
verses.saheeh: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
verses.khattab: by a command from Us, for We have always sent ˹messengers˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿As an ordinance, a distinguishing, from Us. Indeed We have been sending from your Lord, messengers, [such as] Muhammad (s) and those before him,
verses.romanUrdu: Hamare hukum se sadir kiya jata hai. Hum ek Rasool bhejne waley thay

verses.uthmani: رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
verses.indopak: رَحْمَةً مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ ۗ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ ۙ
verses.transliteration: rahmatan min rabbika innahu huwa alssamee'u al'aleemu
verses.saheeh: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.khattab: as a mercy from your Lord. He ˹alone˺ is truly the All-Hearing, All-Knowing—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿as a mercy, out of compassion for those to whom these [messengers] have been sent. Surely He is the Hearer, of their sayings, the Knower, of their actions.
verses.romanUrdu: Tere Rubb ki rehmat ke taur par.Yaqeenan wahi sab kuch sunne aur jaanne wala hai

verses.uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.indopak: رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۘ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّوْقِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena
verses.saheeh: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
verses.khattab: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them (read rabbu’l-samāwāti, in the nominative [to understand it] as a third predicate; or read rabbi’l-samāwāti as a substitution for rabbika, ‘your Lord’), if you should be certain, O people of Mecca, that God, exalted be He, is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, then also be certain that Muhammad (s) is His Messenger.
verses.romanUrdu: Aasmano aur zameen ka Rubb aur har us cheez ka Rubb jo Aasman o zameen ke darmiyan hai agar tum log waqaii yakeen rakhne waley ho

verses.uthmani: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.indopak: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىٖ وَيُمِيْتُ ۗ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ اٰبَاۤٮِٕكُمُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: la ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena
verses.saheeh: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
verses.khattab: There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He ˹alone˺ gives life and causes death. ˹He is˺ your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿There is no god except Him. He gives life and brings death. Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.
verses.romanUrdu: Koi maabood uske siwa nahin hai. Wahi zindagi ata karta hai aur wahi maut deta hai.Tumhara Rubb aur tumhare un aslaaf (forefathers) ka Rubb jo pehle guzar chuke hain

verses.uthmani: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ
verses.indopak: بَلْ هُمْ فِىْ شَكٍّ يَّلْعَبُوْنَ
verses.saheeh: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
verses.khattab: In fact, they are in doubt, amusing themselves
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay, but they linger in doubt, concerning the Resurrection, playing, in mockery of you, O Muhammad (s), and so he said, ‘My God, assist me against them with seven [years of drought] like the seven of Joseph’.
verses.romanUrdu: (Magar fil-waqeh in logon ko yaqeen nahin hai) balke yeh apne shakk mein paday khel rahey hain

verses.uthmani: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٖ مُّبِينٖ
verses.indopak: فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى السَّمَاۤءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: fairtaqib yawma tatee alssamao bidukhanin mubeenin
verses.saheeh: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
verses.khattab: Wait then ˹O Prophet˺ for the day ˹when˺ the sky will be veiled in haze, clearly visible
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: So watch out for the day when the heaven will produce a visible smoke. Thus the earth became barren and famine became so severe that they began to see what looked like smoke rising between the heaven and the earth,
verses.romanUrdu: Accha intezar karo us din ka jab aasman sareeh dhuwan (smoke) liye huey aayega

verses.uthmani: يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
verses.indopak: يَغْشَى النَّاسَ ۗ هٰذَا عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
verses.saheeh: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
verses.khattab: overwhelming the people. ˹They will cry,˺ “This is a painful torment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿that will envelop the people, and so they said: ‘This is a painful chastisement!
verses.romanUrdu: Aur woh logon par chaa jayega, yeh hai dardnaak saza

verses.uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.indopak: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ اِنَّا مُؤْمِنُوْنَ
verses.saheeh: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
verses.khattab: Our Lord! Remove ˹this˺ torment from us, ˹and˺ we will certainly believe.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Our Lord, relieve us from the chastisement; indeed we have believed’, we have [now] affirmed the sincerity of Your Prophet.
verses.romanUrdu: (Ab kehte hain ke) “ parwardigar , humpar se yeh azaab taal de, hum imaan laatey hain”

verses.uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.indopak: اَنّٰى لَهُمُ الذِّكْرٰى وَقَدْ جَاۤءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: anna lahumu alththikra waqad jaahum rasoolun mubeenun
verses.saheeh: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
verses.khattab: How can they be reminded when a messenger has already come to them, making things clear
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: How can there be a reminder for them, that is to say, faith will not benefit them once the chastisement has been sent down, when already there has come to them a manifest Messenger, whose Message is plain [to understand],
verses.romanUrdu: Inki gaflat kahan dur hoti hai? Inka haal to yeh hai ke in ke paas Rasool e mubeen aa gaya

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٞ مَّجۡنُونٌ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوْا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُوْنٌ ۘ
verses.saheeh: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
verses.khattab: then they turned away from him, saying, “A madman, taught by others!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿but they turned away from him and said, ‘He has been taught — that is, a human being is teaching him the Qur'an — [he is] a madman!’
verses.romanUrdu: Phir bhi yeh uski taraf multafit na huey aur kaha ke “ yeh to sikhaya padaya bawla hai (well-tutored madman)”

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا كَاشِفُوا الْعَذَابِ قَلِيْلًا اِنَّكُمْ عَاۤٮِٕدُوْنَ ۘ
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
verses.khattab: Indeed, We will remove ˹that˺ torment for a while, and you ˹Meccans˺ will return ˹to disbelief˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Indeed We will remove the chastisement, the famine from you [for], a little, time; and so it was removed from them. [But] you will indeed revert!’, to your disbelief — and they did.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum zara azaab hataye detay hain, tum log phir wahi kuch karoge jo pehle kar rahe thay

verses.uthmani: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.indopak: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْـرٰى ۚ اِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: yawma nabtishu albatshata alkubra inna muntaqimoona
verses.saheeh: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
verses.khattab: ˹Then˺ on the Day We will deal ˹you˺ the fiercest blow, We will surely inflict punishment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Mention, the day when We shall assault with the most mighty assault — this was the day of [the battle of] Badr — [then] indeed We shall take vengeance, on them (al-batsh, means ‘to seize violently’).
verses.romanUrdu: Jis roz hum badi zarb (assault) lagayenge woh din hoga jab hum tumse intiqaam lenge

verses.uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ كَرِيمٌ
verses.indopak: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ جَاۤءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌ كَرِيْمٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walaqad fatanna qablahum qawma fir'awna wajaahum rasoolun kareemun
verses.saheeh: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,
verses.khattab: Indeed, before them We tested Pharaoh’s people: a noble messenger came to them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And certainly We tried, We tested, before them the people of Pharaoh, together with him, when a messenger came to them, namely, Moses, peace be upon him, who was honoured, before God, exalted be He,
verses.romanUrdu: Hum insey pehle Firaun ki qaum ko isi aazmaish mein daal chuke hain. Unke paas ek nihayat shareef Rasool aaya

verses.uthmani: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
verses.indopak: اَنْ اَدُّوْۤا اِلَىَّ عِبَادَ اللّٰهِ ۗ اِنِّىْ لَـكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ اَمِيْنٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: an addoo ilayya 'ibada allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameenun
verses.saheeh: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
verses.khattab: ˹proclaiming,˺ “Hand over the servants of Allah to me. I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[saying], ‘Give over to me, what I summon you to in the way of faith, that is, manifest your faith to me, O, servants of God; indeed I am for you a messenger [who is] faithful’, in what he has been sent with,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur usne kaha “Allah ke bandon ko mere hawale karo, main tumhare liye ek amanat-daar Rasool hoon

verses.uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
verses.indopak: وَّاَنْ لَّا تَعْلُوْا عَلَى اللّٰهِ ۚ اِنِّىْۤ اٰتِيْكُمْ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: waan la ta'loo 'ala allahi innee ateekum bisultanin mubeenin
verses.saheeh: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.
verses.khattab: And do not be arrogant with Allah. I have certainly come to you with a compelling proof
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and, ‘Do not rebel, [do not] try to act strong, against God, by neglecting obedience to Him. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant’, [clear] proof of [the sincerity of] my Mission — but they threatened to stone him to death.
verses.romanUrdu: Allah ke muqable mein sarkashi na karo. Main tumhare saamne (apni maamuriyat ki) sareeh sanad (clear authority) pesh karta hoon

verses.uthmani: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ
verses.indopak: وَاِنِّىْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّىْ وَرَبِّكُمْ اَنْ تَرْجُمُوْنِ ۚ
verses.saheeh: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
verses.khattab: And indeed, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord so you do not stone me ˹to death˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So he said, ‘And truly I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me, [to death] with rocks.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur main apne Rubb aur tumhare Rubb ki panaah le chuka hoon issey ke tum mujhpar hamla-awar (attack) ho

verses.uthmani: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ
verses.indopak: وَاِنْ لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوْا لِىْ فَاعْتَزِلُوْنِ
verses.saheeh: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
verses.khattab: ˹But˺ if you do not believe me, then let me be.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And if you do not believe me, then stay away from me’, [that is] then refrain from harming me — but they did not refrain from such [action].
verses.romanUrdu: Agar tum meri baat nahin maante to mujhpar haath daalne se baaz raho”

verses.uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ مُّجۡرِمُونَ
verses.indopak: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗۤ اَنَّ هٰۤؤُلَاۤءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُوْنَ‏
verses.transliteration: fada'a rabbahu anna haolai qawmun mujrimoona
verses.saheeh: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
verses.khattab: Ultimately, he cried out to his Lord, “These are a wicked people!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So he called to his Lord, saying, ‘These are indeed a guilty, an idolatrous, lot!’
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar usne apne Rubb ko pukara ke yeh log mujrim hain

verses.uthmani: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىْ لَيْلًا اِنَّكُمْ مُّتَّبَعُوْنَ ۙ
verses.saheeh: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
verses.khattab: ˹Allah responded,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, said: ‘Then set out (read fa-asri or fa’sri) with My servants, the Children of Israel, by night; for you will assuredly be pursued, [surely] Pharaoh and his people will pursue you.
verses.romanUrdu: (Jawab diya gaya) accha to raat-o-raat mere bandon (servants) ko lekar chal padh. Tum logon ka peecha kiya jayega

verses.uthmani: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّغۡرَقُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۗ اِنَّهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُّغْرَقُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waotruki albahra rahwan innahum jundun mughraqoona
verses.saheeh: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
verses.khattab: And leave the sea parted, for they are certainly an army bound to drown.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And leave the sea behind, once you and your companions have crossed it, at rest, still and calm, until the Egyptians enter it: indeed they will be a drowned host’ — he [Moses] was reassured by this [statement] — and they were [indeed] drowned.
verses.romanUrdu: Samandar ko uske haal par khula chodh de.Yeh saara lashkar garq (drown) honay wala hai

verses.uthmani: كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
verses.indopak: كَمْ تَرَكُوْا مِنْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍ ۙ
verses.saheeh: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
verses.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many gardens and springs the tyrants left behind
verses.jalalayn: ﻿How many gardens, orchards, and, flowing, fountains did they leave behind,
verses.romanUrdu: Kitne hi baag aur chasme

verses.uthmani: وَزُرُوعٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ
verses.indopak: وَّزُرُوْعٍ وَّمَقَامٍ كَرِيْمٍ ۙ
verses.saheeh: And crops and noble sites
verses.khattab: as well as ˹various˺ crops and splendid residences
verses.jalalayn: ﻿as well as sown fields and many a glorious residence, [many] a splendid court,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur kheit (gardens) aur shaandaar mahal thay jo woh chodh gaye

verses.uthmani: وَنَعۡمَةٖ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
verses.indopak: وَّنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوْا فِيْهَا فٰكِهِيْنَ ۙ
verses.saheeh: And comfort wherein they were amused.
verses.khattab: and luxuries which they fully enjoyed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the bounty, the comforts, in which they rejoiced!, [in which] they lived luxuriously.
verses.romanUrdu: Kitne hi aish ke sar-o-samaan, jin mein woh mazey kar rahey thay unke pichey dharay reh gaye

verses.uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.indopak: كَذٰلِكَ ۗ وَاَوْرَثْنٰهَا قَوْمًا اٰخَرِيْنَ
verses.saheeh: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
verses.khattab: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to another people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So [it was] (kadhālika is the predicate of a subject [that is missing], such as ‘the matter was [so]’) and We made these an inheritance, that is to say, their riches, for another people, namely, the Children of Israel.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh hua unka anjaam, aur humne dusron ko in cheezon ka waris bana diya

verses.uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
verses.indopak: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَاۤءُ وَالْاَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوْا مُنْظَرِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: fama bakat 'alayhimu alssamao waalardu wama kanoo munthareena
verses.saheeh: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
verses.khattab: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor was their fate delayed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So neither the heaven nor the earth wept for them — in contrast to the [case with] believers, at the point of whose death weep both their places of prayer on earth and the route by which their deeds ascend the heaven; nor were they reprieved, [nor] were they deferred [until they were able] to make repentance.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir na aasman unpar roya na zameen, aur zara si mohalat bhi unko na di gayi

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىْۤ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِيْنِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walaqad najjayna banee israeela mina al'athabi almuheeni
verses.saheeh: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
verses.khattab: And We certainly delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating chastisement, of having their children slain and their womenfolk taken as servants,
verses.romanUrdu: Is taraah bani Israel ko humne sakht zillat ke azaab

verses.uthmani: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
verses.indopak: مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ ۗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ الْمُسْرِفِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: min fir'awna innahu kana 'aliyan mina almusrifeena
verses.saheeh: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
verses.khattab: of Pharaoh. He was truly a tyrant, a transgressor
verses.jalalayn: ﻿from Pharaoh (min Fir‘awna, is said to be a substitution for al-‘adhābi, on the basis of an implied annexation, that is to say, [min] ‘adhābi [Fir‘awna]; or it is said to be a circumstantial qualifier referring to al-‘adhāb, ‘the chastisement’). Truly he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun se najaat di jo hadd se guzar janey walon mein fil waqeh badey unchey darje ka aadmi tha

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنٰهُمْ عَلٰى عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۚ
verses.saheeh: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
verses.khattab: And indeed, We chose the Israelites knowingly above the others
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We chose them, that is, the Children of Israel, with a knowledge, that We had of their state, over [all] the worlds, that is, the worlds of their time, [those of] the rational beings.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unki halat jaante huye, unko duniya ki dursi qaumon par tarjeeh di

verses.uthmani: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٞاْ مُّبِينٌ
verses.indopak: وَاٰتَيْنٰهُمْ مِّنَ الْاٰيٰتِ مَا فِيْهِ بَلٰۤؤٌا مُّبِيْنٌ
verses.transliteration: waataynahum mina alayati ma feehi balaon mubeenun
verses.saheeh: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
verses.khattab: And We showed them signs in which there was a clear test
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We gave them signs in which there was a manifest trial, an obvious grace, such as the parting of the sea, [the sending down of] manna and quails and other such [signs].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unhein aisi nishaniya dikhayi jin mein sareeh aazmaish thi

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ هٰۤؤُلَاۤءِ لَيَقُوْلُوْنَ ۙ
verses.saheeh: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
verses.khattab: Indeed, these ˹Meccans˺ say
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed these ones, that is, the Meccan disbelievers, say,
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh log kehte hain

verses.uthmani: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنْ هِىَ اِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْاُوْلٰى وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنْشَرِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: in hiya illa mawtatuna aloola wama nahnu bimunshareena
verses.saheeh: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
verses.khattab: “There is nothing beyond our first death, and we will never be resurrected
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘It, that death after which there is life, is nothing more than our first death, that is, when they were sperm-drops, and we shall not be resurrected, [we shall not be] raised alive after the second one.
verses.romanUrdu: “hamari pehli maut ke siwa aur kuch nahin uske baad hum dobara uthaye jaane wale nahin hai

verses.uthmani: فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.indopak: فَأْتُوْا بِاٰبَاۤٮِٕنَاۤ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
verses.saheeh: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
verses.khattab: Bring ˹back˺ our forefathers, if what you say is true.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Bring us then our fathers, alive, if you are being truthful’, about our being resurrected after we have died, that is to say, that we will be given life [again].
verses.romanUrdu: Agar tum sacchey ho to utha lao hamare baap dada ko”

verses.uthmani: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡ ۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
verses.indopak: اَهُمْ خَيْرٌ اَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۙ وَّ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ ۗ اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا مُجْرِمِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: ahum khayrun am qawmu tubba'in waallatheena min qablihim ahlaknahum innahum kanoo mujrimeena
verses.saheeh: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
verses.khattab: Are they superior to the people of Tubba’ and those before them? We destroyed them ˹all˺, ˹for˺ they were truly wicked
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: Are they better, or the people of Tubba‘ — [he was] a prophet or a righteous man — and those, communities, before them? We destroyed, because of their disbelief. In other words: they are not mightier than those, and yet they were destroyed; indeed they were criminals.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh behtar hai ya tubbah ki qaum aur ussey pehle ke log? Humne unko isi bina par tabah kiya ke woh mujrim ho gaye thay

verses.uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لٰعِبِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma la'ibeena
verses.saheeh: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
verses.khattab: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, [intending] to play, by creating all that (lā‘ibīna, ‘to play’, is a circumstantial qualifier).
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh Aasman o zameen aur inke darmiyan ki cheezein humne kuch khel ke taur par nahin bana di hai

verses.uthmani: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: مَا خَلَقْنٰهُمَاۤ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: ma khalaqnahuma illa bialhaqqi walakinna aktharahum la ya'lamoona
verses.saheeh: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
verses.khattab: We only created them for a purpose, but most of these ˹pagans˺ do not know
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We did not create them, and all that is between them, except with the truth, that is to say, [We created them] rightfully so that one might infer thereby Our power and Our Oneness and other matters; but most of them, that is, the Meccan disbelievers, do not know.
verses.romanUrdu: Inko humne bar-haqq paida kiya hai, magar aksar log jaante hain hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيْقَاتُهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۙ
verses.saheeh: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
verses.khattab: Surely the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is the time appointed for all—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly the Day of Decision, the Day of Resurrection, in which God will decide between servants, will be the tryst for all of them, for everlasting chastisement;
verses.romanUrdu: In sabke uthaye janey ke liye the-shuda waqt faisle ka din hai

verses.uthmani: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلٗى شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.indopak: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِىْ مَوْلًى عَنْ مَّوْلًى شَيْــًٔا وَّلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: yawma la yughnee mawlan 'an mawlan shayan wala hum yunsaroona
verses.saheeh: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
verses.khattab: the Day no kith or kin will be of benefit to another whatsoever, nor will they be helped
verses.jalalayn: ﻿the day when a friend will not avail a friend, on account of kinship or friendship, that is to say, [the day when] he will not [be able to] ward off from the other, anything, of the chastisement, nor will they be helped — [nor will they] be protected from it (yawma, ‘the day’, is a substitution for yawma’l-fasl, ‘the Day of Decision’),
verses.romanUrdu: Woh din jab koi azeez kareeb apne kisi azeez kareeb ke kuch bhi kaam nahin aayega. Aur na kahin se unhein koi madad pahunchegi

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا مَنْ رَّحِمَ اللّٰهُ ۗ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الرَّحِيْمُ
verses.transliteration: illa man rahima allahu innahu huwa al'azeezu alrraheemu
verses.saheeh: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.khattab: except those shown mercy by Allah. He is truly the Almighty, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except for him on whom God has mercy — and these are the believers, for they will intercede for one another with God’s permission. He is indeed the Mighty, the Victor in His retribution of the disbelievers, the Merciful, to believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Siwaye iske ke Allah hi kisi par reham karey, woh zabardast aur Raheem hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّوْمِ ۙ
verses.saheeh: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
verses.khattab: Surely ˹the fruit of˺ the tree of Zaqqûm
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lo! the tree of Zaqqūm, one of the vilest of the bitter trees of the Tihāma region: God, exalted be He, will make it grow forth in the Hell-fire,
verses.romanUrdu: Zakkhum ka darakht (tree)

verses.uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلۡأَثِيمِ
verses.indopak: طَعَامُ الْاَثِيْمِ ۛ
verses.saheeh: Is food for the sinful.
verses.khattab: will be the food of the evildoer
verses.jalalayn: ﻿will be the food of the sinful, Abū Jahl and his companions, the gravest of sinners.
verses.romanUrdu: Gunahgaar ka kha-ja (khana /food) hoga

verses.uthmani: كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ
verses.indopak: كَالْمُهْلِ ۛ يَغْلِىْ فِى الْبُطُوْنِ ۙ
verses.saheeh: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
verses.khattab: Like molten metal, it will boil in the bellies
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Like molten copper, that is to say, like the dregs of black oil (ka’l-muhli, is the second predicate) it will boil inside the bellies ([if] read taghlī, then it is a third predicate; [if] yaghlī, then it is a circumstantial qualifier referring to al-muhl, ‘molten copper’),
verses.romanUrdu: Tail (oil) ki tiljhat (dregs) jaisa, pait (bellies) mein is tarah josh khayega

verses.uthmani: كَغَلۡيِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
verses.indopak: كَغَلْىِ الْحَمِيْمِ
verses.saheeh: Like the boiling of scalding water.
verses.khattab: like the boiling of hot water
verses.jalalayn: ﻿as the boiling of boiling water, [hamīm means] water of the most extreme temperature.
verses.romanUrdu: Jaise khaulta (boiling) hua pani josh khata hai

verses.uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.indopak: خُذُوْهُ فَاعْتِلُوْهُ اِلٰى سَوَاۤءِ الْجَحِيْمِ ۖ
verses.saheeh: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
verses.khattab: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize them and drag them into the depths of the Hellfire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Seize him, it will be said to the Zabāniya [the Guards of Hell], ‘seize the sinner’, and drag him (read fa‘tilūhu or fa‘tulūhu), haul him away violently and brutally, to the midst of Hell-fire, [al-jahīm means] the centre of the Fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Pakado isey aur raged-te (dragging) huey le jao isko jahannum ke beechon beech

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ صُبُّوْا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهٖ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيْمِ ۗ
verses.saheeh: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
verses.khattab: Then pour over their heads the torment of boiling water.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then pour over his head the torture of boiling water!’, that is to say, the boiling water which is ever-torturous (this [use of ‘the torture of boiling water’] is rhetorically more intense than what is stated by the verse: boiling water will be poured over their heads [Q. 22:19]).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur undhail (pour) do iske sar par khaulte (boiling) paani ka azaab

verses.uthmani: ذُقۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡكَرِيمُ
verses.indopak: ذُقْ ۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْكَرِيْمُ
verses.saheeh: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
verses.khattab: ˹The wicked will be told,˺ “Taste this. You mighty, noble one
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it will be said to him: ‘Taste!, that is, [taste] the chastisement. Indeed you are the mighty, the noble one!, as you claimed when you used to say, ‘There is nothing between its two mountains [sc. Mecca] that is mightier or nobler than me!’
verses.romanUrdu: Chakkh iska maza, bada zabardast izzatdaar aadmi hai tu

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ هٰذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَمْتَرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: inna hatha ma kuntum bihi tamtaroona
verses.saheeh: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
verses.khattab: This is truly what you ˹all˺ used to doubt.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it will be said to them: This, that you see of the chastisement, is indeed that which you used to doubt’, about which you used to be uncertain.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh wahi cheez hai jiske aane mein tumlog shakk rakhte thay”

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٖ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِىْ مَقَامٍ اَمِيْنٍ ۙ
verses.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;
verses.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly the God-fearing will be in a secure place, a seat in which there will be security from [all] fear,
verses.romanUrdu: Khuda tars log aman ki jagah mein hongey

verses.uthmani: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
verses.indopak: فِىْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍ ۙ
verses.saheeh: Within gardens and springs,
verses.khattab: amid Gardens and springs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿amid gardens, orchards, and springs,
verses.romanUrdu: Baaghon (gardens) aur chashmo mein

verses.uthmani: يَلۡبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٖ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.indopak: يَّلْبَسُوْنَ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَّاِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيْنَ ۚ ۙ
verses.saheeh: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
verses.khattab: dressed in fine silk and rich brocade, facing one another
verses.jalalayn: ﻿dressed in fine silk and [heavy] silk brocade, that is to say, in fine and thick silks (sundusin wa’stabraqin, respectively), sitting face to face (mutaqābilīna is a circumstantial qualifier), that is to say, they do not look upon each other backs, since the couches revolve with them in them.
verses.romanUrdu: Hareer-o-deeba (silk and brocade) ke libas pehne, aamne saamne baithey honge

verses.uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ
verses.indopak: كَذٰلِكَ ۗ وَزَوَّجْنٰهُمْ بِحُوْرٍ عِيْنٍ ۗ
verses.saheeh: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
verses.khattab: So it will be. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So [shall it be] (an implied al-amru, ‘the matter’, should be read as preceding this); and We shall pair them, either in conjugality or [meaning] We shall join them, with houris of beautiful eyes, women of the fairest complexion with wide and beautiful eyes.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh hogi inki shaan aur hum gori gori aah-o-chashm auratein unse biyah denge

verses.uthmani: يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.indopak: يَدْعُوْنَ فِيْهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ اٰمِنِيْنَ ۙ
verses.saheeh: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
verses.khattab: There they will call for every fruit in serenity
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They will call, they will request from servants, therein, that is, in Paradise, to bring, every fruit, thereof, [remaining] secure, [in their knowledge] that it will not come to an end or cause harm and [secure] from all danger (āminīna, ‘secure’, is a circumstantial qualifier’).
verses.romanUrdu: Wahan woh itminaan se har tarah ki lazeez cheezein talab karenge

verses.uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.indopak: لَا يَذُوْقُوْنَ فِيْهَا الْمَوْتَ اِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْاُوْلٰى ۚ وَوَقٰٮهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيْمِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: la yathooqoona feeha almawta illa almawtata aloola wawaqahum 'athaba aljaheemi
verses.saheeh: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
verses.khattab: There they will never taste death, beyond the first death. And He will protect them from the punishment of the Hellfire—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They will not taste death therein, other than the first death, namely, the one [that came] in this world after they had lived in it (some [scholars] think that illā, ‘other than’, here means ba‘da, ‘after’). And He will shield them from the chastisement of Hell-fire —
verses.romanUrdu: Wahan maut ka maza woh kabhi na chakhenge . Bas duniya mein jo maut aa chuki so aa chuki aur Allah apne fazal se

verses.uthmani: فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
verses.indopak: فَضْلًا مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ ۗ ذٰ لِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيْمُ
verses.transliteration: fadlan min rabbika thalika huwa alfawzu al'atheemu
verses.saheeh: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
verses.khattab: as ˹an act of˺ grace from your Lord. That is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph
verses.jalalayn: ﻿a bounty from your Lord (fadlan is a verbal noun, with the sense of tafaddulan, and is in the accusative [dependent status] because of an implied [preceding] tafaddala). That is the supreme triumph.
verses.romanUrdu: Unko jahannum ke azaab se bacha dega yahi badi kamiyabi hai

verses.uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
verses.saheeh: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.
verses.khattab: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so perhaps they will be mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿For We have made it easy, We have facilitated the Qur'an, in your tongue, in your language, so that the Arabs may understand it from you, that perhaps they may remember, [that perhaps] they may be admonished and become believers — but they do not believe.
verses.romanUrdu: Aey Nabi (s.a.s) humne is kitaab ko tumhari zubaan mein sahal (easy / aasaan) bana diya hai taake yeh log nasihat hasil karein

verses.uthmani: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ
verses.indopak: فَارْتَقِبْ اِنَّهُمْ مُّرْتَقِبُوْنَ
verses.saheeh: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
verses.khattab: Wait then! They too are certainly waiting
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So be on the look out, await their destruction. Indeed they [too] are on the look out, for your death — this was before the revelation of the command to struggle against them.
verses.romanUrdu: Ab tum bhi intezar karo, yeh bhi muntazir (intezar kar rahey) hain
